বন্ধুত্বপূর্ণ ভাব, খোলামেলা ও সরল সদাশয়তা

Relating to or resembling a monastery (where monks or nuns live), esp. by being quiet, secluded, contemplative, strict, and/or lacking luxuries

Bury (a dead body) or place in a tomb
Give a rough outline of; foreshadow; reveal only partially; obscure
রূপরেখা দেওয়া; পূর্বাভাস দেওয়া; আংশিক প্রকাশ করা; আড়াল করা
Stroke of luck, something accidentally successful
Discussion, negotiation, esp. between enemies (noun); to have such a discussion (verb)
আলোচনা, দরকষাকষি, বিশেষত শত্রুদের মধ্যে (বিশেষ্য); এমন আলোচনা করা (ক্রিয়া)
Sift, analyze critically, separate the useful part from the worthless part
ঝেড়ে বাছাই করা, সমালোচনামূলকভাবে বিশ্লেষণ করা, কাজের অংশ অকাজের অংশ থেকে আলাদা করা

Place where a river or similar body of water is shallow enough to walk or ride a vehicle across (noun); to cross at such a place (verb)
নদী বা এমন জলাশয়ের এমন একটি জায়গা যা এত অগভীর যে হেঁটে বা যান নিয়ে পার হওয়া যায় (বিশেষ্য); এমন জায়গায় পার হওয়া (ক্রিয়া)
Varied in color, having multicolored patches or spots; diverse
রঙের বৈচিত্র্যপূর্ণ, বহুরঙা ছোপ বা দাগযুক্ত; বিচিত্র

অনুসন্ধানী বা ভেদী ভঙ্গিতে; নিবিড়ভাবে পরীক্ষা করে বা উত্তরের খোঁজে
A deep and vast space or cavity; anything profound or infinite
গভীর ও বিশাল শূন্যস্থান বা গহ্বর; যেকোনো অতল বা অসীম কিছু
Legal or judicial inquiry, especially before a jury and especially made by a coroner into the cause of someone’s death; the results of such an inquiry

verses.a: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
verses.e: When My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near.
So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me.

verses.a: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
verses.e: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.
Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct your longing.
And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
And say: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance.

verses.a: وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَـٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
verses.e: And give me a supporting authority from Yourself.
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
Give good news to the patient.
Allah loves the patient.
Be patient; indeed, Allah is with the patient.
Be patient, and your patience is only through Allah.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make ease for him in his affairs.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
verses.e: Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for him.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make ease for him in his affairs.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
verses.e: Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for him.

verses.a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.e: Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.

verses.a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.e: Allah does not allow the reward of the believers to be lost.
Allah is with you and will never deprive you of your deeds.

verses.a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا
verses.e: Allah does not allow the reward of one who does good to be lost.

verses.a: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.e: A person will have only what he strives for.
His effort will surely be seen.
Then he will be fully rewarded for it.
Then proceed to the remembrance of Allah.

verses.a: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَانتَشِرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ
verses.e: When the prayer is concluded, disperse through the land.
And seek the bounty of Allah.
Remember Allah much so that you may succeed.
Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him.
And those who do good.

verses.a: إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.e: The mercy of Allah is near to those who do good.
My mercy encompasses all things.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
Indeed, Allah forgives all sins.
Turn back to your Lord.

verses.a: وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ
verses.e: Submit to Him before the punishment comes.
Who can forgive sins except Allah?
They do not persist knowingly in what they have done.
Those who restrain anger and pardon people.
Allah loves those who do good.
Allah loves the patient.
Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.

verses.a: وَمَن يَغْفِرْ وَيَصْفَحْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.e: Whoever pardons and overlooks, then indeed Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Indeed, Allah loves those who constantly repent.
And He loves those who purify themselves.

verses.a: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ
verses.e: Allah does not change a people’s condition until they change what is within themselves.
Allah is fully aware of what you do.

verses.a: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ
verses.e: O believers, fear Allah.
Let every soul look to what it has sent ahead for tomorrow.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out.
And He will provide for him from where he does not expect.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
verses.e: Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for him.
Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make ease for him in his affairs.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will remove his misdeeds from him.
And He will magnify his reward.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out.
Indeed, I am near.
I respond to the call of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.
So let them respond to Me.
And let them believe in Me.
So that they may be rightly guided.

verses.a: وَمَن يَعْتَصِم بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِيَ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.e: Whoever holds firmly to Allah has been guided to a straight path.
Hold firmly, all together, to the rope of Allah.
Do not dispute, lest you lose courage and your strength depart.
And be patient.
Obey Allah and His Messenger.
If you support Allah, He will support you.
And He will make your feet firm.
So do not weaken and call for peace.
Allah is with you.
Those who strive for Us, We will surely guide them to Our ways.
Indeed, Allah is with those who do good.
Those who believe and do righteous deeds.

verses.a: إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجْرَ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ عَمَلًا
verses.e: We do not allow the reward of one who does good to be lost.
Whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord.
Let him do righteous work.
And let him not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord.
Those who believe in what has been revealed to you.
And they establish prayer.
And they spend from what We have provided them.
Those are upon guidance from their Lord.
And it is those who are successful.
Whoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart.
Allah is Knowing of all things.
Certainly the believers have succeeded.
Those who are humble and attentive in their prayer.
Those who turn away from useless speech and activity.
Those who are active in giving zakah.
Those who faithfully observe their trusts and covenants.
Those who carefully maintain their prayers.
Those are the inheritors.
Those who will inherit al-Firdaus.
They will abide therein eternally.
Indeed, Allah loves those who are mindful of Him.
Indeed, Allah loves those who rely upon Him.

verses.a: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَيَصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.e: Whoever fears Allah and is patient, then Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.

hadith.t: “Actions are judged by intentions.”
“The best of you are those who learn the Qur’an and teach it.”
“Speak good or remain silent.”
“None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.”
“The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak, yet both have good. Be keen on what benefits you and seek Allah’s help.”
“Make things easy, not difficult. Give glad tidings, do not repel.”
“Smiling at your brother is charity.”
“Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge, Allah eases for him a path to Paradise.”
“Two blessings many people lose: health and free time.”
“The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.”
“Be in this world like a stranger or a traveler.”
“Whoever relieves a believer’s hardship, Allah relieves his hardship on the Day of Judgment.”
“Allah looks not at your appearance or wealth, but at your hearts and deeds.”
“How wonderful is the believer’s affair: all of it is good for him.”
“Whoever shows no mercy will be shown no mercy.”
“Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.”
“The strong person is the one who controls himself in anger.”
“Do not become angry.”
“A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand others are safe.”
“Charity never decreases wealth.”
“The upper (giving) hand is better than the lower (receiving) hand.”
“Protect yourself from the Fire, even with half a date.”
“True richness is richness of the soul.”
“Look at those below you, not above you; it keeps you from belittling Allah’s blessings.”
“Whoever says ‘SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi’ 100 times a day, his sins are forgiven even if like the sea’s foam.”
“Two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful: ‘SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-’Azim.’”
“Allah says: ‘I am as My servant thinks of Me.’”
“Your mother, then your mother, then your mother, then your father.”
“Whoever wants his provision expanded and life extended, let him keep family ties.”
“The best of you are those with the best character.”
“Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good one to erase it, and treat people with good character.”
“Every son of Adam errs, and the best of those who err are those who repent.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2499 · Sunan Ibn Majah 4251 · Hasan

hadith.t: “Part of the excellence of a person’s Islam is leaving what does not concern him.”
“Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you.”
“When Allah wants good for someone, He tests him.”
“No fatigue, worry, or sadness, even a thorn’s prick, befalls a believer except Allah expiates his sins through it.”
“True patience is at the first strike of calamity.”
“If you relied on Allah as He deserves, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds.”
“When a person dies, his deeds end except three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, and a righteous child who prays for him.”
“If a Muslim plants a tree and anything eats from it, it is charity for him.”
“Whoever guides to good has a reward like the one who does it.”
“Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise.”
“No one has eaten better food than what he earned by his own labor.”
“A believer to a believer is like a building, each part strengthening the other.”
“Whoever conceals a Muslim’s fault, Allah will conceal his faults.”
“Every good deed is charity.”
“Whoever fasts Ramadan with faith and hope for reward, his past sins are forgiven.”
“Du’a (supplication) is worship.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 3371 · Sunan Abi Dawud 1479 · Sahih

hadith.t: “Your Lord is Generous and Shy; He is shy to return empty the hands of His servant raised to Him.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 1488 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 3556 · Sahih

hadith.t: “Modesty brings nothing but good.”
“The best deed is prayer at its proper time.”
“Cleanliness is half of faith.”
“Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah builds for him a house in Paradise.”
“Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Fajr and ’Asr) will enter Paradise.”
“The five daily prayers wash away sins like a river at your door.”
“Prayer in congregation is 27 degrees better than praying alone.”
“Whoever performs wudu well, his sins leave his body.”
“Fasting is a shield.”
“Whoever fasts one day for Allah, Allah distances his face from the Fire by seventy years.”
“Whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr with faith and hope, his past sins are forgiven.”
“The best charity is what you give while healthy and holding on to wealth.”
“A good word is charity.”
“Allah is pure and accepts only what is pure.”
“Whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 4811 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 1954 · Sahih

hadith.t: “Jibril kept advising me about the neighbor until I thought he would make him an heir.”
“Beware of suspicion. Do not envy, hate, or turn away from one another; be servants of Allah, brothers.”
“The religion is sincere advice.”
“Allah has prescribed excellence (ihsan) in everything.”
“Faith has over seventy branches; the highest is ‘La ilaha illallah,’ the lowest is removing harm from the road, and modesty is a branch of faith.”
“Whoever has three things tastes the sweetness of faith: loving Allah and His Messenger most, loving a person only for Allah, and hating to return to disbelief.”
“He has tasted faith who is content with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad as messenger.”
“In the body is a piece of flesh; if it is sound, the whole body is sound. It is the heart.”
“If you have no shame, do as you wish.”
“Allah is more merciful to His servants than a mother to her child.”
“Allah says: ‘My mercy prevails over My wrath.’”
“Allah says: ‘O son of Adam, as long as you call upon Me and hope in Me, I forgive you.’”
“The one who repents from sin is like one who has no sin.”
“Allah extends His hand at night to accept the repentance of those who sinned by day, and by day for those who sinned by night.”
“Whoever repents before the sun rises from the west, Allah accepts his repentance.”
“The best dhikr is ‘La ilaha illallah,’ and the best du’a is ‘Alhamdulillah.’”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 3383 · Sunan Ibn Majah 3800 · Hasan

hadith.t: “Whoever says ‘La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lah...’ 100 times a day, it equals freeing ten slaves and his sins are erased.”
“The one who remembers his Lord and the one who does not are like the living and the dead.”
“Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah sends ten upon him.”
“Whoever seeks to be independent, Allah makes him independent; patience is the best and widest gift.”
“The best of you are the best to their families.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 3895 · Sunan Ibn Majah 1977 · Sahih

hadith.t: “The most complete believers in faith are those with the best character.”
“I and the guardian of an orphan will be in Paradise like these two (two fingers together).”
“The one who strives for widows and the poor is like a fighter in Allah’s cause.”
“The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One above will be merciful to you.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 4941 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 1924 · Sahih

hadith.t: “The truthful, trustworthy merchant will be with the prophets, the truthful, and the martyrs.”
“A person follows the religion of his close friend, so look carefully at whom you befriend.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 4833 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2378 · Hasan

hadith.t: “Leave what makes you doubt for what does not.”
“A believer is not stung from the same hole twice.”
“A man gave water to a thirsty dog and Allah forgave him. There is reward in serving any living being.”
“Whoever sees wrong, let him change it by hand; if unable, by tongue; if unable, by heart.”
“Whoever fears sets out early, and whoever sets out early reaches the destination. The goods of Allah are precious: Paradise.”
“Take on only the deeds you are able to do.”
“Whoever goes to the mosque morning or evening, Allah prepares hospitality for him in Paradise each time.”
“The most beloved places to Allah are the mosques.”
“The best of you are those who are best in repaying debts.”
“Deeds are judged by their endings.”
“Religion is ease. Be moderate, strive, and seek help in the morning, evening, and part of the night.”
“Hasten to good deeds before trials come like pieces of dark night.”
“When Allah wants good for someone, He gives him understanding of the religion.”
“Seeking knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim.”
“Whoever recites one letter of Allah’s Book earns a good deed, multiplied by ten.”
“Prayer is light, charity is proof, and patience is illumination.”
“The skilled reciter of the Qur’an is with the noble angels, and one who struggles through it gets double reward.”
“Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah al-Baqarah at night, they suffice him.”
“Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.”
“Gentleness adorns whatever it is in.”
“Whoever is deprived of gentleness is deprived of all good.”
“Whoever suppresses his anger while able to act on it, Allah calls him before all creation.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 4777 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2021 · Hasan

hadith.t: “Reconciling between people is better than fasting, prayer, and charity.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 4919 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2509 · Sahih

hadith.t: “The best Islam is to feed people and greet those you know and those you do not.”
“Spread salam, feed others, keep family ties, and pray at night while people sleep; you will enter Paradise in peace.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2485 · Sunan Ibn Majah 3251 · Sahih

hadith.t: “One who visits the sick remains in the fruit-garden of Paradise until he returns.”
“The believer who mixes with people and bears their harm is better than the one who does not.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2507 · Sunan Ibn Majah 4032 · Sahih

hadith.t: “The greater the trial, the greater the reward.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2396 · Sunan Ibn Majah 4031 · Hasan

hadith.t: “When a servant is ill or traveling, he is recorded the same deeds he did when healthy and settled.”
“Whoever intends a good deed but does not do it, a full good deed is written for him.”
“Whoever calls to guidance gets a reward equal to those who follow him.”
“Whoever starts the day safe, healthy, and with food for the day, it is as if he owns the world.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2346 · Sunan Ibn Majah 4141 · Hasan

hadith.t: “The world is a prison for the believer.”
“Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and Hell by desires.”
“Each of you is a shepherd and responsible for his flock.”
“Allah is pleased with the servant who eats a meal and praises Him for it.”
“The words most beloved to Allah are four: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, Allahu Akbar.”
“‘La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah’ is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.”
“Whoever says ‘SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi,’ a palm tree is planted for him in Paradise.”
“Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty.”
“When Allah loves a servant, He tells Jibril, ‘I love him, so love him.’”
“Charity extinguishes sin as water extinguishes fire.”
“Whoever prays twelve rak’ahs (sunnah) in a day and night, a house is built for him in Paradise.”
“Two rak’ahs of Duha are enough to cover the charity owed for every joint of the body.”
“Whoever prays Isha in congregation is as one who prayed half the night.”
“The best prayer after the obligatory is the night prayer.”
“Whoever fasts Ramadan and follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is like fasting the whole year.”
“An accepted Hajj has no reward except Paradise.”
“Whoever performs Hajj without obscenity or sin returns as on the day his mother bore him.”
“Among the best deeds are faith in Allah, striving in His cause, and an accepted Hajj.”
“Whoever meets Allah without associating anything with Him enters Paradise.”
“When you ask Allah, ask for Al-Firdaws, the highest part of Paradise.”
“None of you should die except while thinking well of Allah.”
“A man was forgiven for removing a thorny branch from the road.”
“Whoever is tested through daughters and treats them well, they will be a shield for him from the Fire.”
“Righteousness is good character.”
“The nearest to me on the Day of Judgment will be those with the best character.”
“Allah says: ‘My servant draws near to Me with voluntary deeds until I love him.’”
“The most fortunate by my intercession is whoever said ‘La ilaha illallah’ sincerely from his heart.”
“The believer is not one who eats his fill while his neighbor goes hungry.”
“Believers in their mutual love and mercy are like one body; if one part aches, the whole body responds.”
“You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Spread salam among you.”
“Exchange gifts and you will love one another.”
“Whoever is not merciful to our young and does not respect our elders is not of us.”
“Honoring an elderly Muslim is part of honoring Allah.”
“Whoever wants to be saved from the Fire and enter Paradise should die believing in Allah and treat people as he would like to be treated.”
“Beware of injustice, for injustice will be darkness on the Day of Judgment.”
“Beware the supplication of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah.”
“Pay the worker his wage before his sweat dries.”
“Whoever deceives us is not one of us.”
“The signs of a hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when trusted he betrays.”
“Be content with what Allah has given you and you will be the richest of people.”
“Tie your camel, then rely on Allah.”
“I like good omens, which are a good word.”
“Say, ‘I believe in Allah,’ then be steadfast.”
“No one will enter Paradise by his deeds alone, not even me, unless Allah envelops me in His mercy. So be moderate and aim for what is right.”
“The bankrupt person is one who comes with prayer, fasting, and charity but has wronged others, so his good deeds are given to them.”
“Allah is pleased with three things for you: that you worship Him alone, hold fast to His rope together, and sincerely advise those given authority over you.”
“I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him more than seventy times a day.”
“Whoever says Sayyid al-Istighfar with conviction during the day and dies before evening is of the people of Paradise.”
“The closest a servant is to his Lord is while in prostration, so make much supplication.”
“Allah descends to the lowest heaven in the last third of the night and says: ‘Who calls upon Me, that I may answer him?’”
“Whoever prays Fajr is under Allah’s protection.”
“A Muslim’s supplication for his brother in his absence is answered; the angel says, ‘Amen, and the same for you.’”
“Three supplications are not rejected: a parent’s for their child, a traveler’s, and the oppressed’s.”
hadith.r: — Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 1905 · Sunan Abi Dawud 1536 · Hasan

hadith.t: “The Prophet’s most frequent supplication: ‘Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the Fire.’”
“O Allah, I seek refuge in You from helplessness and laziness.”
“Whoever glorifies, praises, and magnifies Allah 33 times each after every prayer, his sins are forgiven even if like the foam of the sea.”
“Surah al-Ikhlas is equal to a third of the Qur’an.”
“Every tasbih, tahmid, tahlil, and takbir is a charity.”
“The best day on which the sun rises is Friday.”
“Seek Laylat al-Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten nights of Ramadan.”
“Whoever feeds a fasting person earns the same reward as him, without reducing the faster’s reward.”
“O young people, whoever is able should marry, for it lowers the gaze and protects chastity; whoever is unable should fast, for it is a shield.”
“The world is enjoyment, and the best enjoyment of the world is a righteous wife.”
“Whoever is done a favor and says ‘Jazakallahu khayran’ to the doer has done the utmost in praise.”
“Allah is Witr (One) and loves the Witr, so pray Witr, O people of the Qur’an.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 1416 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 453 · Sahih

hadith.t: “The best of people are my generation, then those who follow them, then those who follow them.”
“None of you truly believes until I am more beloved to him than his parents, his children, and all people.”
“Allah accepts the repentance of the servant as long as the death rattle has not reached his throat.”
“Whoever says ‘Astaghfirullah al-’Azim alladhi la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayy al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh’ is forgiven, even if he fled from battle.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 1517 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 3577 · Sahih

hadith.t: “Whoever guarantees me what is between his jaws and between his legs, I guarantee him Paradise.”
“A man may speak a word pleasing to Allah without giving it thought, and Allah raises him in ranks because of it.”
“The best jihad is a word of truth in front of an unjust ruler.”
hadith.r: — Sunan Abi Dawud 4344 · Jami’ at-Tirmidhi 2174 · Sahih

hadith.t: “A believer is a mirror to his fellow believer.”
“Whoever obeys me enters Paradise, and whoever disobeys me has refused.”

“Seven will be shaded by Allah on the Day with no shade but His: a just ruler, a youth raised in worship, one whose heart is attached to the mosques, two who love each other for Allah, one who refuses temptation out of fear of Allah, one who gives charity in secret, and one who weeps remembering Allah alone.”
“Allah does not accept prayer without purification, nor charity from wealth taken unlawfully.”
“Whoever dies knowing that there is no god but Allah enters Paradise.”
